items.title_en: Flash Flood on Nepal-Tibet Border Kills More Than 150, With Hundreds of Tourists Missing
items.summary_en: A catastrophic flash flood and mudslide struck the Nepal-Tibet border region on Wednesday, triggered by a massive landslide and possible glacial collapse rather than an earthquake. More than 150 people have been confirmed dead in Nepal, with over 400 tourists missing from across the globe. The missing include more than 100 Indian nationals, 54 Americans, 34 Australians, 53 Ukrainians, 33 British citizens, and 24 Canadians, along with more than 100 Nepali residents. In Tibet, Chinese state media reports three dead and 265 missing. The disaster struck the Bhotekoshi River in Nepal's Rasuwa district, a popular pilgrimage and trekking destination near sacred sites. Entire villages have been wiped away with widespread destruction to homes, roads, and bridges. The US Geological Survey confirmed that seismic energy was generated by a landslide, not an earthquake. Nepal's meteorology department suggests a massive ice chunk collapsed from a mountain, pulling down rocks and sediments. The international community has responded with aid pledges, including $500,000 from the United States for emergency shelter and sanitation. Rescue operations continue with helicopters deployed across the affected areas.
items.title_zh: 尼泊爾─西藏邊界閃洪災難逾 150 人喪生
items.summary_zh: 尼泊爾─西藏邊界地區週三遭遇一場災難性閃洪及泥石流，這場災難由巨大山崩和冰川崩塌引發，而非最初認為的地震。尼泊爾已確認超過 150 人喪生，全球各地數百名遊客失蹤。失蹤人員包括逾 100 名印度籍人士、54 名美國人、34 名澳洲人、53 名烏克蘭人、33 名英國人和 24 名加拿大人，以及逾 100 名尼泊爾居民。在西藏方面，中國官媒報導 3 人喪生、265 人失蹤。災難發生在尼泊爾盧薩瓦縣的波蒂科西河，該地是著名的朝聖地和登山地點，靠近聖地。整個村莊被沖毀，房屋、道路和橋樑普遍受到破壞。美國地質調查局確認地震能量是由山崩而非地震產生。尼泊爾氣象部門認為一大塊冰從山上崩落，帶動岩石和沉積物。國際社會已作出援助承諾，包括美國提供的 50 萬美元用於緊急避難所和衛生設施。救援行動持續進行，直升機已部署至受影響地區。

items.title_en: Meta Reaches Up To $18 Billion Settlement Over Child Safety Claims With State Attorneys General
items.summary_en: Meta Platforms has agreed to an unprecedented up to $18 billion settlement with 48 state attorneys general and four US territories, bringing an end to a landmark federal child safety trial. The multistate settlement, which must be approved by federal judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers, includes $17.1 billion in penalties plus $459 million from previous Cambridge Analytica privacy violations, totaling up to $18 billion over a 10-year period. The states alleged that Meta intentionally designed Facebook and Instagram to encourage compulsive use among young users, knew from internal research that teenagers were experiencing mental health harms, and failed to disclose those risks publicly. Under the settlement terms, Meta must implement a default two-hour daily time limit for users under 18, nighttime blocks between midnight and 6 am, school mode disabling notifications from 8 am to 3 pm, and a non-personalized feed option. Meta must also ban cosmetic procedure filters for minors, display like counts, and implement enhanced parental supervision tools. Additionally, Meta will appoint an independent auditor with expansive access to ensure compliance. The settlement halted a trial that was expected to run through October, with states originally seeking over $1.4 trillion in damages.
items.title_zh: Meta 與美國 48 州達成 18 億美元兒童安全和解
items.summary_zh: Meta 平台已與 48 個州檢察長和 4 個美國地區達成史無前例的高達 18 億美元的和解協議，終止了一場具里程碑意義的聯邦兒童安全訴訟。該多州和解協議須由聯邦法官 Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers 批准，包括 171 億美元罰款加上先前劍橋分析隱私違規的 4.59 億美元，10 年期間總計高達 18 億美元。各州主張 Meta 故意設計 Facebook 和 Instagram 以鼓勵年輕使用者強迫性使用，從內部研究中瞭解青少年正經歷心理健康危害，但未公開披露這些風險。根據和解條款，Meta 必須為 18 歲以下使用者實施預設的每日兩小時時間限制、午夜至上午 6 點的夜間鎖定、上午 8 點至下午 3 點停用通知的學校模式，以及非個性化動態消息選項。Meta 亦須禁止未成年人使用美容手術濾鏡、顯示按讚數，並實施強化家長監督工具。此外，Meta 將任命獨立審計員進行全面監督以確保遵守。該和解終止了原定運行至 10 月的訴訟，各州最初尋求超過 1.4 兆美元的賠償。

items.title_en: England vs Pakistan Second Test Begins at Lord's Cricket Ground in London
items.summary_en: England and Pakistan commenced their second Test match at Lord's Cricket Ground in London on Thursday, August 27, 2026, marking Pakistan's first visit to the prestigious venue since 2018. The five-day Test match runs from August 27 through August 31, with play starting at 11:00 AM local time. The match is part of Pakistan's three-Test tour of England during the summer season. Lord's, one of cricket's most iconic venues located in St John's Wood, continues its tradition of hosting international cricket matches. The toss will determine which team bats first. England enters the match with recent form in the series, having won their first Test against Pakistan earlier in the tour. Pakistan's squad aims to compete at the historic ground where both teams have contested numerous memorable encounters. The England vs Pakistan rivalry remains one of Test cricket's most compelling matchups, with significant historical context at Lord's. Match hours include a lunch break from 1:00 PM to 1:40 PM, tea from 3:40 PM to 4:00 PM, with play concluding at 6:00 PM daily. The live coverage will be broadcast on BBC Sport, providing comprehensive ball-by-ball commentary and analysis throughout the Test.
items.title_zh: 英格蘭與巴基斯坦勳爵板球場第二場測試賽開始
items.summary_zh: 英格蘭與巴基斯坦於 2026 年 8 月 27 日星期四在倫敦的勳爵板球場開始第二場測試賽，這標誌著自 2018 年以來巴基斯坦首度造訪該著名場地。五天制測試賽從 8 月 27 日至 31 日進行，每日比賽時間為上午 11 點開始。該場比賽是巴基斯坦夏季英格蘭三場測試賽巡迴賽的一部分。位於聖約翰伍德的勳爵板球場是板球最具標誌性的場地之一，繼續秉承舉辦國際板球比賽的傳統。擲硬幣將決定哪支隊伍先行擊球。英格蘭隊以該巡迴賽中的最近表現進入比賽，在早前的測試賽中擊敗了巴基斯坦。巴基斯坦隊希望在這個歷史悠久的場地上與英格蘭隊競爭。英格蘭與巴基斯坦的對抗仍然是測試板球中最引人注目的對陣之一，在勳爵板球場有重要的歷史背景。比賽時間包括每日午餐休息（下午 1 點至 1 點 40 分）、下午茶時間（下午 3 點 40 分至 4 點），比賽於每日下午 6 點結束。BBC 體育將進行現場轉播，在整個測試賽期間提供全面的逐球評述和分析。
